0022600189.text: The Indiana Pacers (3-6, 11th in the East and 3.5 games back in the Central) meet the Denver Nuggets (4-3, 9th in the West and 2 games back in the Northwest) in the NBA Mexico City Game, a neutral-site contest that is Indiana's 10th game of the season, with Indiana on a W1 streak and Denver also on a W1 streak. Indiana is without Tyrese Haliburton (hamstring strain, 21.8 points and 33.0 minutes per game this season), Ben Sheppard (knee), Johnny Furphy (knee, surgery), and T.J. McConnell (hamstring strain), while Kelly Oubre Jr. (calf bruise) is day-to-day and a game-time decision. Denver is missing Julian Strawther (knee sprain) and Spencer Jones (hamstring), and DeMar DeRozan (back spasms) is day-to-day and a game-time decision; the teams have not played each other yet in 2026-27, and the Pacers lost 0-2 to Denver in the 2025-26 season series, most recently falling 135-120 in Indianapolis on December 3, 2025.
